description: LunarWing multi-tenant agent infrastructure monorepo: Rust daemon (ic/), channels, Podman-first sandboxed execution, orchestration, web gateway, missions, and the WASM/MCP extension ecosystem.
rules: Core daemon source lives in ic/; subsystem specs (CLAUDE.md, README.md) are authoritative over general docs.

Build, test, and lint from ic/ (Rust 2024, MSRV 1.96.1). Use cargo check for compile verification instead of full debug builds; on Gentoo, prefix Cargo commands with taskset -c 0-11 and limit parallel jobs to 12.

Add new DB operations to the shared DB trait first; implement both backends unless libSQL work is disproportionate. Then document PostgreSQL-only behavior in the relevant spec, and preserve existing libSQL coverage when possible.
Security-sensitive surfaces (auth, secrets, sandboxing, approvals, listeners) must not be weakened; sandbox execution is fail-closed with SANDBOX_NETWORK=none by default.
WASM extensions and MCP integrations are preferred for plugin-style capabilities; keep entrypoints orchestration-focused.
